1.	The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 7.7.9.2.5-1.

2.	Message contents are defined in Clause 7.7.9.2.4.3.

3.	There are two inter-frequency cells specified in the test, where Cell 1 is the serving cell on an NR FR2 carrier and Cell 2 is the neighbour cell on a different NR FR2 carrier and the target cell for the CSI-SINR measurements. The TCI status for Cell 1 is defined in Table A.3.16.2-1 in TS 38.133 [6] and TRS configuration for Cell 1 is defined in Table A.3.17.2.1-1 in TS 38.133 [6].

4.	The UE Rx beam peak direction has been obtained previously using one of the Rx Beam Peak Search procedures as described in Annex I.

###### 7.7.9.2.4.2	Test procedure

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] Clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Table 7.7.9.2.5-1 and 7.7.9.2.5-2 as appropriate.

3.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1.

4.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

5.	The UE shall transmit periodically *MeasurementReport* messages.

6.	After 10s wait from Step 3, the SS shall check the CSI-SINR reported values in the periodic *MeasurementReport* . The CSI-SINR value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to the expected CSI-SINR. If the value is outside the limits (determined by Table 7.7.9.0.2.1-1 and Table 7.7.9.0.2.1-2) or the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations is increased by one.

7.	The SS shall continue checking the *MeasurementReport* messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G is achieved.

8.	Set the parameters according to each sub-test in Table 7.7.9.2.5-1 and 7.7.9.2.5-2 as appropriate and repeat steps 5-7.

###### 7.7.9.2.5	Test Requirement

The CSI-SINR absolute measurement accuracy in test 1 shall be within the range Nominal CSI-SINR +XdB to Nominal CSI-SINR –X-1dB and the CSI-SINR measurement accuracy in test 2 shall be within the range Nominal CSI-SINR +YdB to Nominal CSI-SINR –Y-1dB according to the requirements in 7.7.9.0.2.1 with an additional -1dB margin reflecting the possible impact of UE self noise in the test.

The CSI-SINR relative measurement accuracy shall fulfil the requirements in Clause 7.7.9.0.2.2.

Editor’s note: The values of X and Y are pending on the accuracy requirement discussion.

#### 7.7.10 to 7.7.13

#### 7.7.14	L1-RSRP measurement for group-based beam reporting

####### 7.7.14.1	NR SA FR2 SSB based L1-RSRP measurement for group-based beam reporting

Editor’s note: This test case is incomplete. The following aspects are either missing or TBD:

- TT is missing.

-	Configuration of 3AoA setup and testability of the device is still FFS.

###### 7.7.14.1.1	Test Purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the L1-RSRP measurement accuracy for group-based beam reporting is within the specified limits. This test will verify the requirements as defined in clauses 9.5.2 and 10.1.20.1 of TS 38.133[6] for SSB based L1-RSRP measurements.

###### 7.7.14.1.2	Test Applicability

This test applies to all types of NR PC3 UE release 18 onwards that support *groupBasedBeamReporting-r17.*

###### 7.7.14.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clauses 7.7.4.0.1 and 7.7.4.0.2

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clauses A.7.7.14.1

###### 7.7.14.1.4	Test description

###### 7.7.14.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 7.7.14.1.4.1-1.

Table 7.7.14.1.4.1-1: Supported Test Configurations

| Config   | Description                                            |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| 1        | NR 120 kHz SSB SCS, 100 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |
| 2        | NR 240 kHz SSB SCS, 100 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |
| Note:	The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations in each supported band          | Note:	The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations in each supported band                                                        |

1.	Configure the test equipment and the DUT according to the parameters in Table 7.7.4.1.4.1-2.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 7.7.14.1.4.3.

3.	The test scenario comprises of 1 NR FR2 Cell. There is no measurement gap configured in the test. Before the test, UE is configured two CSI resource sets with one SSB resource in each set.

4.	UE is configured with *groupBasedBeamReporting-r17* for SSB index 0 and SSB index 1.

5.	UE is configured to perform RLM and BFD based on SSB 0 and UE is configured to perform group-based L1-RSRP measurement based on the SSB resources 0 and 1.

###### 7.7.14.1.4.2	Test procedure

Same as in clause 7.7.4.1.4.2 except Step 4 R1 scenario.

4.	The UE shall start sending valid L1-RSRP reports, a valid report shall meet the absolute L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#0 and SSB#1 and the relative L1-RSRP requirement for SSB1. The SS shall check for the following requirements:

- R1: The L1-RSRP values of SSB#0 and SSB#1 are reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-RSRP values for SSB#0 and SSB#1. If the value is outside the limits in Table 7.7.14.1.5-3 (depending on the test configuration) or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#0 and SSB#1, the number of failed iterations for R1 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R1 is increased by one.

###### 7.7.14.1.4.3	Message contents

Message contents are same as in clause 7.7.4.1.4.3 with the following exceptions:

Table 7.7.14.1.4.3-1: Common Exception messages

| Default Message Contents                                          | Default Message Contents                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Common contents of system information blocks exceptions           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Default RRC messages and information elements contents exceptions | Table H.3.1-1 Table H.3.1-2 Table H.3.6-2 with conditions PERIODIC, SS-RSRP and  groupBasedBeamReporting as enabled Table H.3.6-3 with conditions SSB and PERIODIC Table 7.3.1-3 in TS 38.508-1 [14] with condition SMTC.1 |

###### 7.7.14.1.5	Test requirements

Table 7.7.14.1.5-1 and 7.7.14.1.5-2 define the primary level settings including the test tolerances for all tests.

Same as in clause 7.7.4.1.5 with below exceptions:

After 320ms from the beginning of the test, the L1-RSRP measurement accuracy for SSB#0 and SSB#1 of Cell 1 shall fulfil the requirements as defined in clauses 7.7.4.0.1, 7.7.4.0.2 TS 38.133 [6] 10.1.20.1. The following requirements are to be verified:

For Test 1:

Absolute accuracy of SSB0 and SSB1. The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the reported L1-RSRP is in the range shown in Table 7.7.4.1.3-1.

Relative accuracy of SSB0 compared with SSB1. The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the difference in reported L1-RSRP meets the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] Table 10.1.20.1.2-1.

For Test 2:

Absolute accuracy of SSB resource reported by UE in L1-RSRP report (SSB0 or SSB1). The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the reported L1-RSRP is in the range shown in Table 7.7.4.1.3-1.

Relative accuracy of SSB0 compared with SSB1. The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the difference in reported L1-RSRP meets the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] Table 10.1.20.1.2-1.

####### 7.7.14.2	NR SA FR2 CSI-RS based L1-RSRP measurement on resource set with repetition off

Editor’s note: This test case is incomplete. The following aspects are either missing or TBD:

- Test requirement shall require an update.

- TT is missing

- Configuration of 3AoA setup and testability of the device is still FFS

###### 7.7.14.2.1	Test Purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the L1-RSRP measurement accuracy for group-based beam reporting is within the specified limits. This test will verify the requirements as defined in clauses 9.5.3 and 10.1.20.2 of TS 38.133 [6] for L1-RSRP measurements based on CSI-RS.

###### 7.7.14.2.2	Test Applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE from Release 17 onwards supporting *groupBasedBeamReporting-r17.*

###### 7.7.14.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 7.7.4.0.3 and 7.7.4.0.4.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clauses 9.5.3, 10.1.20.2 and A.7.7.14.2.

###### 7.7.14.2.4	Test description

###### 7.7.14.2.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 7.7.14.2.4.1-1.

Table 7.7.14.2.4.1-1: Supported Test Configurations

|   Config | Description                                               |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        1 | NR 120 kHz CSI-RS SCS, 100 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |

Same as in clause 7.7.4.2.4.1 with the following exceptions:

1.	The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 7.7.4.2.4.1-2.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 7.7.4.2.4.3.

3.	The test scenario comprises of 1 NR FR2 Cell. There is no measurement gap configured in the test. Before the test, UE is configured two CSI resource sets with one CSI-RS resource in each set.

4.	UE is configured with *groupBasedBeamReporting-r17* for CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1.

5.	UE is configured to perform RLM and BFD based on SSB 0 and 1 and UE is configured to perform group-based L1-RSRP measurement based on the CSI resources.

6.	CSI-RS resources are not transmitted in the same OFDM symbols as SSB. The connection setup is done according to the settings in Annex C.1.1.

7.	The rx beam peak and directions in which the UE meets the EIS spherical coverage criteria have been found with one of the procedures from Annex I.

###### 7.7.14.2.4.2	Test procedure

Same as in clause 7.7.4.2.4.2 except Step 4 R1 scenario.

4.	The UE shall start sending valid L1-RSRP reports, a valid report shall meet the absolute L1-RSRP requirement for CSI-RS0 and the relative L1-RSRP requirement for CSI-RS1. The SS shall check for the following requirements:

- R1: The L1-RSRP values of CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1 are reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-RSRP values for CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1. If the value is outside the limits in Table 7.7.14.2.5-3 (depending on the test configuration) or the UE fails to report the measurement value for CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1, the number of failed iterations for R1 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R1 is increased by one.

###### 7.7.14.2.4.3	Message contents

Same as in clause 7.7.4.2.4.3 with the following exceptions:

Table 7.7.14.2.4.3-1: Common Exception messages

| Default Message Contents                                          | Default Message Contents                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Common contents of system information blocks exceptions           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Default RRC messages and information elements contents exceptions | Table H.3.1-1 Table H.3.1-2 Table H.3.6-2 with conditions PERIODIC, CSI-RSRP and  groupBasedBeamReporting as enabled Table H.3.6-3 with conditions CSI-RS and PERIODIC Table 7.3.1-3 in TS 38.508-1 [14] with condition SMTC.1 |

###### 7.7.14.2.5	Test requirements

Table 7.7.14.2.5-1 and 7.7.14.2.5-2 define the primary level settings including the test tolerances for all tests.

Same as in clause 7.7.4.2.5 with the following exceptions:

After 640ms from the beginning of the test, the L1-RSRP measurement accuracy for CSI-RS#0 and CSI-RS#1 of Cell 1 shall fulfil the requirements as defined in clauses 7.7.4.0.3, 7.7.4.0.4 and in TS 38.133[6] clause 10.1.20.2. The following requirements are to be verified:

For Test 1:

Absolute accuracy of CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1. The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the reported L1-RSRP is in the range shown in TS 38.133[6] clause A.7.7.4.2.3 Table A.7.7.4.2.3-1.

Relative accuracy of CSI-RS0 compared with CSI-RS1. The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the difference in reported L1-RSRP meets the requirements defined in TS 38.133 [6] Table 10.1.20.2.2-1.

. For Test 2:

Absolute accuracy of CSI-RS resource reported by UE in L1-RSRP report (CSI-RS0 or CSI-RS1). The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the reported L1-RSRP is in the range shown in TS 38.133[6] clause A.7.7.4.2.3 Table A.7.7.4.2.3-1.

Relative accuracy of CSI-RS0 compared with CSI-RS1. The UE is deemed to meet the requirement if the difference in reported L1-RSRP meets the requirements defined in TS 38.133 [6] in Table 10.1.20.2.2-1.

#### 7.7.15	LTM L1-RSRP measurement

##### 7.7.15.0	Minimum conformance requirements

###### 7.7.15.0.1	SSB based absolute L1-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements

Unless otherwise specified, the requirements for absolute accuracy of SSB based L1-RSRP in this clause apply to all SSBs of candidate neighbour cell(s) on a frequency in FR2 that is on a different frequency than the serving cell.

The accuracy requirements in Table 7.7.15.0.1-1 are valid under the following conditions:

-	Conditions defined in clause 7.3 of TS 38.101-1 [2] for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

-	Conditions for L1-RSRP measurements are fulfilled according to TS 38.133 [6] Annex B.2.4.1 for a corresponding band for each relevant SSB.

-	The measured signals are in the directions covered by the percentile EIS spherical coverage of the UE, defined in clause 7.3.4 of TS 38.101-2 [3].

###### 7.7.15.0.2	SSB based relative L1-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements

The relative accuracy of SSB based L1-RSRP is defined as the L1-RSRP measured on one SSB configured in *LTM-CSI-ResourceConfig* on one cell on a frequency in FR2 compared to the value of L1-RSRP measured from another SSB configured in *LTM-CSI-ResourceConfig* from any other cell on another frequency in FR2.

The accuracy requirements in Table 7.7.15.0.2-1 are valid under the following conditions:

-	Conditions defined in clause 7.3 of TS 38.101-1 [2] for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

-	Conditions for L1-RSRP measurements are fulfilled according to TS 38.133 [6] Annex B.2.4.1 for a corresponding band for each relevant SSB.

-	|SSB\_RP1 dBm - SSB\_RP2 dBm| ≤ 27 dB

-	|Channel 1\_Io - Channel 2\_Io| ≤ 20 dB

-	The measured signals are in the directions covered by the percentile EIS spherical coverage of the UE, defined in clause 7.3.4 of TS 38.101-2 [3].

##### 7.7.15.1	NR SA FR2 SSB based inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement

Editor's Note: This test case is incomplete in following aspects:

-  TT analysis is complete for UE PC3

-  TT analysis is complete for test frequencies f ≤ 40.8 GHz

-  TT analysis is complete for normal conditions

###### 7.7.15.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the SSB based inter-frequency L1-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy on neighbor cell is within the limits for all bands specified in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1.20B.

###### 7.7.15.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE supporting SSB based inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurements with measurement gaps and reports for LTM from release 18 and forward.

###### 7.7.15.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 7.7.15.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.7.7.15.1.

###### 7.7.15.1.4	Test description

###### 7.7.15.1.4.1	Initial conditions

4.	The AoA setup for this test is Setup 1 as defined in clause A.9. The UE RX beam peak direction has been obtained previously using one of the search procedures as described in Annex I.

###### 7.7.15.1.4.2	Test procedure

UE is indicated to perform inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement on the SSBs and report periodically.

There are two tests in the test case, test 1 and test 2:

-	In test 1, test at the highest power level below maximum Io.

-	In test 2, test at the lowest power level above minimum SSB\_RP.

Measurement gap pattern configuration defined in Table 7.7.15.1.4.1-3 is provided.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity NR SA, Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Test 1 in Table 7.7.15.1.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit *RRCReconfiguration* message to configure Event A4 triggered measurement report.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

5.	The UE shall transmit *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A4 including Cell 2 measurement report with SSB index.

6.	SS shall transmit *RRCReconfiguration* message to configure *LTM-Candidate-r18* for Cell 2. UE is configured with SSB-based L1-RSRP measurements and periodic L1-RSRP measurement reports for candidate Cell 2 in PUCCH format 2.

7.	The UE shall transmit *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

8.	The UE shall transmit L1-RSRP on PUCCH format 2 in Cell 1 with a periodicity of 320 slots.

9.	After 10s wait from Step 6, the SS shall check the values in the periodic measurement report. The L1-RSRP value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-RSRP value. If the reported value is outside the limits in Table 7.7.15.1.5-3 for test configuration 1 and in Table 7.7.15.1.5-4 for test configuration 2, or if the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations is increased by one.

10.	The SS shall continue checking the L1-RSRP report transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G is achieved.

11.	The SS shall transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

12.	Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current Cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

13.	After the RRC connection release, the SS:

- transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity NR SA, Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5 (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity NR SA, Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.),

OR

- switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity NR SA, Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

14.	Set the parameters according to each test in Table 7.7.15.1.5-1 as appropriate and repeat steps 3-13.
